caption: __init__ runs automatically; self.role stores data on this object.

code:
msg1 = ChatMessage("user", "What's the weather?")
msg2 = ChatMessage("assistant", "It's sunny.")
print(msg1.role, msg2.role)
# user assistant
caption: Two objects, same blueprint, completely separate state.

code:
class ChatMessage:
    default_model = "gpt-4"   # shared

    def __init__(self, role, content):
        self.role = role       # per-instance
        self.content = content

m = ChatMessage("user", "hi")
print(m.default_model)
# gpt-4
caption: Class attributes default every instance; instance attributes vary per object.

subtitle: Building a new class on top of an existing one.
